entities.summary: Susan Mary Yeats, known as Lily Yeats, was an embroiderer associated with the Celtic Revival. In 1908 she founded the embroidery department of Cuala Industries, with which she was involved until its dissolution in 1931. She is known for her embroidered pictures. Lily Yeats was a architects & designers from Enniscrone (1866-08-25, Enniscrone–1949-01-05). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
